bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder August 23, 2018

Come see a master artist, Larry Folding, create a watercolor painting of a famous, historical Provincetown dune shack at a free demo on Saturday, August 25 from 2 to 4 PM at the Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists. And perhaps he’ll share some stories from staying in one!

The Art Gallery (source page unavailable) is located at 551 Main Street (Rte. 28) in Harwich Port, (508) 432-1012. Free parking across the street at the Harwich Chamber of Commerce Visitors Information Center.
